details.goal: Repair recorder API, strict serialization and epoch-keyed fingerprints without changing generation behavior.
details.contract: Opt-in only (PI_WEB_CACHE_MONITOR=1); disabled means no key/directory/capture. Installed SDK 1.5.0 gate cleared; IDs are Pi Web local, fingerprints observed objects not wire bytes. API createCacheMonitor({enabled,directory,now?,randomUUID?}); readonly localEpochId:string|null; beginInvocation({localStreamId,invocationIndex,provider,modelId?,configId?}) returns readonly handle|null; recordRequest(handle,{payload}); recordResponse(handle,{usage?}); markUnknown(handle|null,reason); close({drain?}):Promise<void>. Handle contains localEpochId/localInvocationId/localStreamId UUIDv4, invocationIndex safe nonnegative, provider openai|anthropic|google|other, nullable modelId/configId strings. Pending max64; release on response/unknown/close, not request; never retain payload. Exact record keys: schema_version=1,local_epoch_id,local_invocation_id,local_stream_id,sequence,invocation_index,timestamp_ms,provider,model_id_hash,config_id_hash,event_type,association,fingerprints,usage,incomplete. sequence monotonic per epoch. event_type request|response|unknown; association paired|unmatched|retry_ambiguous|telemetry_gap|context_reset|incomplete_fingerprint. Unknown(null) uses all-zero invocation/stream UUID sentinel; epoch stays UUIDv4. fingerprints exactly {prompt:null|{hmac_sha256,bytes,complete}}; response/unknown prompt null. usage null or exactly input_tokens/output_tokens/cache_read_tokens/cache_write_tokens, nullable integers 0..2147483647; invalid usage null/incomplete, no inferred zero. Fresh random 32-byte memory-only epoch key; lowercase 64-hex HMAC model/config/prompt domains pi-web-cache-monitor:v1:model|config|prompt, framed uint32BE tag length/tag/uint32BE data length/data. Missing model/config null. Canonical JSON sorts own enumerable data keys; accepts null,boolean,finite number,string,array,plain object only; reject getters,symbols,cycles,nonplain prototypes,unsafe __proto__/constructor/prototype keys,unsupported values. Bounds depth32,nodes10000,string UTF-8 64KiB,total128KiB; reject whole invalid input, null/incomplete fingerprint, never hash prefix. Existing queue cap64/1MiB, record16KiB including newline; drops tag next event telemetry_gap/incomplete. Fail-open, no raw content/model/config/headers/paths persisted; no dependency/network/build/service changes. Prior attempt: 3 tests passed but TS2339 association/incomplete at line97; storage/retention/drain and secure-read failures remain recorded in progress and are separate ordered repair work.

details.goal: Integrate opt-in recorder through isolated per-session streamSimple wrapper without changing callbacks, streams or generation errors.
details.contract: Installed SDK1.5.0 alignment and operator gate cleared; no install/restart needed. SDK sdk.js reads options.modelRuntime and streamSimple; agent-session-services.js passes services.modelRuntime. At createAgentSessionFromServices shallow-copy services and Proxy existing modelRuntime per session; never mutate shared runtime/prototype. Intercept only streamSimple, invoke original with Reflect.apply(original,target,args). Other properties Reflect.get(target,key,target), bind function values to target for private receivers. Monitor API createCacheMonitor({enabled,directory,now?,randomUUID?}); beginInvocation({localStreamId,invocationIndex,provider,modelId?,configId?})=>handle|null; recordRequest(handle,{payload}); recordResponse(handle,{usage}); markUnknown(handle|null,reason); close({drain?}):Promise<void>. One random UUIDv4 localStreamId/session, monotonic invocationIndex/call even synchronous throw; provider enum openai|anthropic|google|other; no unkeyed hashes or wire/SDK-ID claims. PI_WEB_CACHE_MONITOR=1 only; off means no wrapper capture,key,directory. Clone options only and wrap onPayload: call original once with original arguments, await; effective payload replacement unless undefined then original; observe after success, return exact callback value, propagate exact rejection. Catch all observer failures. More than one payload observation marks retry_ambiguous, never pairs. Return exact original stream immediately, never consume iterator/replace result. Detached result().then observer checks stopReason: error/aborted=>unmatched; stop/length/toolUse plus exactly1 successful payload=>response; zero=>telemetry_gap; multiple=>retry_ambiguous; unknown stop reason=>unmatched. Extract only plain usage.input/output/cacheRead/cacheWrite to nullable input_tokens/output_tokens/cache_read_tokens/cache_write_tokens integers0..2147483647, invalid/missing null, ignore cost/content. Rejection or synchronous stream creation throw=>markUnknown unmatched, rethrow original synchronous error. Observer handlers swallow their own errors. Keep monitor failure from generation; wrapper lifecycle shutdown calls close with explicit drain policy, no post-close capture. Existing shutdown behavior preserved. No raw content/headers/endpoints/paths/model/config persisted. No dependencies/network/build/service changes.

details.goal: Prevent unsupported payload comparisons and false cache-cause claims.
details.contract: Preserve read-only CLI node scripts/analyze-cache-monitor.mjs <capture-dir>, exact schema validation, all-or-nothing output and caps16files/1MiBfile/4MiBtotal/16KiBline/2MiBreport. No network/dependency/build/service actions or raw content/IDs in reports. Pair only exact local tuple (local_epoch_id,local_invocation_id,local_stream_id), exactly one request and one successful response. invocation_index orders comparisons, never pairs. Validate consistent provider/model/config/index across tuple; conflicting metadata invalidates invocation. Deduplicate byte-identical record key(epoch,invocation,stream,event_type,sequence); conflicting duplicates produce telemetry_gap and suppress affected comparisons. Detect sequence gaps within epoch only, not globally; gap evidence conservatively suppresses comparisons across affected interval/epoch when attribution unavailable. Group comparisons by(epoch,stream,provider,model_id_hash,config_id_hash); both hashes nonnull. Unique contiguous invocation indices required; duplicate indices across distinct invocations ambiguous, no comparison.
